# Retry boundary tests follow the actual interval array after rebasing

The progressive-retry reviewer asks to drive one attempt past the interval array, assert the call count and restore the URL preference. The final assigned test has four short intervals, resolves when count exceeds times.length, asserts five calls and restores the URL. An earlier review suggestion said six; a later row explicitly corrects it to five after rebase. Use the final source and fixture data when interpreting this historical test request. The reviewer’s .at(-1) and shorter-normal-interval ideas remain alternatives; actual production code bounds the index with Math.min. Static inspection only; no timing or network test ran.

Scope: In-app notification retry tests.
